newsitem.title: HONG KONG: HK interbank rates steady, govt paper yields up.
newsitem.headline: HK interbank rates steady, govt paper yields up.

text.p: Hong Kong intermarket bank rates held steady, but government paper yields rose slightly on Monday, dealers said.
The overnight remained unchanged at 5-3/16 1/8 percent. Three-month rates traded at 5-9/16 1/2 percent from 5-15/32 7/16 at Friday's midsession.
The market was quiet due to a holiday in the U.S. and Singapore, a local bank dealer said.
Hong Kong government paper yields were a little firmer in line with last week moves by U.S. Treasuries, a regional bank dealer said.

Yields of 10-year Exchange Fund notes gained 7.27 percent against 7.25 at midday on Friday while seven-year were up a fraction at 6.98 percent against 6.97. Five-year notes yielded 6.69 percent versus 6.66 and three-year notes 6.14 percent against 6.13 percent.
Short-dated one-week Exchange Fund bills were at 4.87 percent against 4.84 at Friday's midsession.
